+class _AiohttpResponse(object):
+    def __init__(self, status_code, reason, headers, content):
+        self.status_code = status_code
+        self.reason = reason
+        self.headers = headers
+        self.content = content
+

+class _AiohttpSession(object):
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.auth = None
+        self.headers = {}
+
+    def _client_auth(self):
+        if isinstance(self.auth, tuple):
+            return aiohttp.BasicAuth(self.auth[0], self.auth[1])
+        return self.auth
+
+    async def _request(self, method, url, data=None, timeout=None, headers=None):
+        request_headers = dict(self.headers)
+        if headers:
+            request_headers.update(headers)
+
+        client_timeout = aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=timeout)
+        async with aiohttp.ClientSession(headers=request_headers, auth=self._client_auth()) as session:
+            async with session.request(method, url, data=data, timeout=client_timeout, headers=headers) as response:
+                body = await response.read()
+                try:
+                    content = body.decode()
+                except UnicodeDecodeError:
+                    content = body
+                return _AiohttpResponse(response.status, response.reason, dict(response.headers), content)
+
+    def request(self, method, url, data=None, timeout=None, headers=None):
+        try:
+            asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        except RuntimeError:
+            return asyncio.run(self._request(method, url, data=data, timeout=timeout, headers=headers))
+
+        import threading
+
+        result = {}
+        error = {}
+
+        def _runner():
+            loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
+            try:
+                asyncio.set_event_loop(loop)
+                result['value'] = loop.run_until_complete(
+                    self._request(method, url, data=data, timeout=timeout, headers=headers)
+                )
+            except BaseException as exc:
+                error['value'] = exc
+            finally:
+                loop.close()
+
+        thread = threading.Thread(target=_runner)
+        thread.start()
+        thread.join()
+
+        if error:
+            raise error['value']
+        return result['value']
